correctness.rationale: Derive active-set count by coordinate inclusion–exclusion; every Boolean input point is an exposed vertex. Published Boolean Minkowski theorem gives unique coordinate-support prime factorization. Multiplicative vertex counts make the set-partition recurrence exact. Pair-collision estimate yields f(k)^d/k! with exponential relative correction. For every nontrivial multiplicative partition of k, its exponential base is a sum of f(k_i); coarsening strictly increases that sum. The real-variable derivative shows the uniquely dominant pair is the smallest prime divisor p and k/p. Multinomial concentration yields each fixed factorization leading constant including equal-cardinality symmetry; finitely many alternatives have smaller bases. Closed D4,D6,D9 formulas were derived from 2- and 3-vertex counts. The embedded standalone enumeration and recurrence checked all tested configurations. Limitations: no growing-k uniformity, finite checks are corroborative only.
